name: Lying Barbell Triceps Extension
how_to:
1. Setup:
  - Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
  - Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
  - Extend your arms fully above your chest, keeping a slight bend in the elbows to prevent joint strain.
2. Lowering Phase:
  - Inhale and slowly lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
  - Keep your elbows stationary and pointed upward throughout the movement.
  - Lower the barbell until it is just above your forehead or slightly behind your head.
3. Lifting Phase:
  - Exhale and extend your elbows to push the barbell back to the starting position.
  - Focus on contracting the triceps as you straighten your arms.
  - Avoid locking out your elbows at the top to maintain muscle tension.
4. Repetitions and Breathing:
  - Perform 8-12 repetitions per set, depending on your training goal.
  - Maintain controlled breathing throughout the movement.
